aav-francia32-f49v-54v.summary: Sega on League Paris under Navarre's blockade: passports that angered Navarre, Cardinal de Gondi refusing the oath, Brissac's mission, a request for troops and victuals, Saint-Denis, plots at Orleans, Nantes and Chalon, a divided Union and the plan to put Paris under the protection of the Holy See.

Square brackets: words supplied from the context or the clear text, or gaps ([...]) where the cipher is not read. Translated from reading.md; where the Italian has unresolved words the English follows the sense of the surrounding clear text and says so.

[f. 49v] ... but would to God that this were the only ground of his hope [Navarre's hope of seeing Paris fall through the “practice of commerce”]; but there are so many others besides, such as [...] the instruction I sent to Your Most Illustrious Lordship with my letter of the twenty-sixth of November, and I shall speak of it in its place. May God help us! [f. 50r] As for the passports and letters patent issued on that occasion, [...] precisely what I foretold has happened:
